posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Someone who's going to be online during the afternoon or evening on Saturday or Sunday, wanna help me add one more game to the tally for Pydro's "SOTM Weekend"?  You need to be able to post every ten minutes or so for a period of several hours; I'll run the villain and environment decks, and would prefer a smallish number of other heroes (one other player with two heroes, or 2-3 with one each).

You can use any hero except Nightmist, and I'll pick the villain and environment from the selection I have available.
